name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
title: KPI Green Energy Ltd - 542323 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: KPI Green FY26 PAT Rs509cr (+57%) on IPP ramp, but inventory up ~4x, interest up ~130% and CPP order book (Rs5,246cr) fell short of the Rs6,000cr cited last quarter; execution risk rising.

capex.quote: we have added more capacity. We have taken -- we have started 250-megawatt, 370 megawatt and then also our 240 megawatts.

triggers.label: Inventory up ~4x YoY
triggers.quote: we've seen substantial increase in inventory, about a 4x increase in inventory and 2x increase in inventory days

triggers.label: Growth guide 50-60% → 40-50%
triggers.quote: we are now speaking about 40%, 50%. Could you help us understand why this decrease?

triggers.label: IPP capacity to ~1.7GW this FY
triggers.quote: we are planning to get it in this financial year, 1.7 gigawatt on the IPP side

triggers.label: CPP order book Rs5,246cr
triggers.quote: we have approximately INR5,246 crores of order book on the CPP side

guidance.quote: we are binded to grow at a rate of 40% to 50% year-on-year

guidance.value: ROE back to earlier levels next year
guidance.quote: next year, we'll see again ROE coming back to the earlier levels. That is what we are targeting.
We are on track to achieve our 10-gigawatt target by 2030

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are speaking about 50% to 60%, but now we are seeing about 40%, 50%

red_flags.label: Inventory ~4x YoY, days doubled
red_flags.quote: we have stocked inventory because we have huge orders which have lined up

red_flags.label: Interest cost up ~130%, peak ~Rs300cr
red_flags.quote: Our interest cost is up almost 130% to INR182 crores

red_flags.label: Growth guidance cut without explanation
red_flags.quote: There I don't see any decrease, 50% to 60% is there and 40% to 50%.

red_flags.label: Order book figures inconsistent
red_flags.quote: out of INR5,426 crores, INR1,500 crores is already executed

red_flags.label: Promoter pledge ~50% of shares
red_flags.quote: around 50% of the promoter shares are pledged

evasions.quote: I'll give you an exact calculation out of the total capacity in the order book. So out of INR5,426 crores

evasions.topic: Order-to-capacity conversion and EPC pricing split
evasions.quote: we cannot give that breakup in the public domain because it's our business
As of today, we are not sure how much it will be impacted.
There I don't see any decrease, 50% to 60% is there and 40% to 50%.
